BiblicalUsage: A bundle is what the reapers gather and tie together, and in the parable of the wheat and the tares the bundles are for the fire. The tares are gathered first and bound in bundles to be burned, while the wheat is gathered into the barn.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the bundles at harvest are a sober picture of sorting; God sees the difference between wheat and tare even when I cannot, and the harvest will gather each to its own end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
